title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Regional Road Project

description.narrative: The Project aims to develop strategic international highways and improve road sustainability in Uzbekistan. It will improve 131 kilometers (km) of the A-380 highway; and assist the Government in strengthening operation and maintenance of the road network in Uzbekistan.

contact-info.website: https://www.adb.org/forms/request-information-form?topic=projects&source=PDS&subject=39669-013 (Closed)&officer= KTLUU@YAHOO.COM&division= Transport and Communications Division, CWRD&projectcountry= Uzbekistan

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved regional connectivity and an adequate, efficient, and sustainable road network in Uzbekistan

By 2013, number of cross-border trucks on A-380 (Daudata Custom Post) increased from 10 trucks/day (2007 baseline) to 17 trucks/day Progress/Status: Achieved Cross-border trucks increased from 10 trucks/day (2007) to 19 trucks/day (2013). Data Source: Periodic traffic reports of Uzavtoyul Actual value:

Accident rate reduced by 50% on A-380 highway from 150 accidents per year (2008 estimate) Progress/Status: Achieved In 2013, there were 3 fatal accidents, 2 serious accidents and 1 minor accident recorded on the project roads, an 88% reduction from 2007. Data Source: Road Fund's periodic communications reports and accidents statistics Actual value:

By 2013, total traffic volume of A-380 in Republic of Karakalpakstan increased from 360 vpd (2007 baseline) to 800 vpd and in Khorezm from 1,900 vpd (2007 baseline) to 3,600 vpd Progress/Status: Achieved In 2013, the AADT in Karakalpakstan increased to 1,618 (km 916) and 9,687 (km 876), and in Khorezm increased to 4,248. Data Source: Periodic traffic reports of Uzavtoyul Actual value:

By 2013, capacity of Road Equipment Pool Company improved with new equipment to the level of 10 (on 1-10 scale) from the level of 5 in 2007. REPC's performance maintained at 80% operating ratio Progress/Status: Achieved Debt-equity ratio of 80.7:19 3 achieved for 2013. Operating ratio of 78.1% achieved for 2013. Data Source: REPC's operating performance report Actual value:
